book_name: 会让你在IELTS写作与口语考试中更像一个Native Speaker

words.tr: 某事是一个艰巨的过程（adj. 艰巨的；费力的；艰苦的）
words.ex: Learning to play the piano is an arduous process.
words.ex_cn: 学习弹钢琴是一个艰难的过程。
words.en: sth. be an arduous process: Something is a long, difficult, and tiring task or series of actions.

words.tr: phrase. v. 集中精力于某事；专注于某事物
words.ex: He must concentrate on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他必须专心做作业。
words.en: To focus all one's attention or effort on a particular object or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 运用横向思维；采用非传统或创造性的方式思考问题
words.ex: He used lateral thinking to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他用横向思维解决了这个谜题。
words.en: To use lateral thinking means to approach problems or situations from a new or unusual angle, rather than by traditional step-by-step logic.

words.tr: phrase. 学术表现；学业成绩
words.ex: His academic performance improved after he studied harder.
words.ex_cn: 他更努力学习后，学业表现提高了。
words.en: The achievement or success in academic studies or work, often measured by grades or other assessments.

words.tr: phrase. 机械记忆；死记硬背
words.ex: He passed the test by rote memorisation.
words.ex_cn: 他通过死记硬背通过了考试。
words.en: The process of learning something by repeating it many times without thinking about it or understanding it.

words.tr: phrase. 广泛阅读；大量阅读；博览群书
words.ex: He reads extensively to improve his English.
words.ex_cn: 他广泛阅读以提高英语水平。
words.en: To read a wide range of materials or topics in order to gain knowledge or understanding.

words.tr: phrase. 正直行为的标准
words.ex: He lives by the standard of upright conduct.
words.ex_cn: 他以正直的行为准则为生活准则。
words.en: The level of moral integrity and ethical behavior expected.

words.tr: phrase. 模范；榜样
words.ex: My teacher is my role model.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师是我的榜样。
words.en: A role model is a person whose behavior, example, or success is or can be emulated by others, especially by younger people.

words.tr: phrase. 达到某人的期望；符合某人的预期
words.ex: He worked hard to meet someone's expectations.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以达到别人的期望。
words.en: To fulfill or satisfy what someone anticipates or hopes for.

words.tr: 短语动词. 涉及很多内容；走很远的路；在短时间内完成大量工作
words.ex: We cover a lot of ground in our science class.
words.ex_cn: 我们的科学课涵盖了很多内容。
words.en: To cover a lot of ground means to deal with a wide range of topics or areas in a discussion, presentation, or piece of work.

words.tr: phrase. 自定进度学习；学习者根据自身节奏安排学习进程的教育方式
words.ex: He uses self-paced learning to study math at home.
words.ex_cn: 他使用自主节奏学习在家学习数学。
words.en: Self-paced learning refers to an instructional strategy that allows learners to progress through a course at their own speed, without the constraints of a fixed schedule.

words.tr: phrase. 教育的目标；教育的目的
words.ex: The aims of education are to help students learn and grow.
words.ex_cn: 教育的目标是帮助学生学习和成长。
words.en: The objectives or goals that education seeks to achieve, encompassing the development of knowledge, skills, and values in individuals.

words.tr: phrase. 促进平等；推动平等
words.ex: The school works to promote equality for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校努力促进所有学生的平等。
words.en: To promote equality means to support or encourage the principle that all people should have equal rights and opportunities.

words.tr: n. 男女同校
words.ex: The school has coeducation for all grades.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校所有年级都是男女合校。
words.en: The education of males and females in the same institution.

words.tr: phrase. 反社会行为；破坏公共秩序的行为，如滋扰、破坏公物或暴力行为
words.ex: He shows anti-social behaviour by ignoring others.
words.ex_cn: 他通过忽视他人表现出反社会行为。
words.en: Anti-social behaviour refers to actions that harm or lack consideration for the well-being of others, often violating social norms and laws.

words.tr: n. 青春期
words.ex: He was shy during his adolescence.
words.ex_cn: 他在青春期时很害羞。
words.en: Adolescence is the period in a person's life when they develop from a child into an adult.

words.tr: phrase. 退学；辍学
words.ex: He dropped out of school last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年退学了。
words.en: To leave a school or university before you have finished your studies.

words.tr: phrase. 能说两种语言的；双语的
words.ex_cn: 他会说英语和西班牙语，所以是双语者。
words.en: To be bilingual means to be able to speak two languages fluently.

words.tr: phrase. 偷懒；懈怠；不认真工作
words.ex: He slack off when the teacher isn't looking.
words.ex_cn: 当老师没注意时，他偷懒。
words.en: To be lazy or to do something with less effort or energy than is required.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 破坏性的学生；指在课堂或学校环境中行为扰乱秩序、影响教学的学生
words.ex: The teacher sent disruptive students to the office.
words.ex_cn: 老师把捣乱的学生送到了办公室。
words.en: Students who behave in a way that interrupts lessons and disturbs others.

words.tr: phrase. 满足……的需求；符合……的要求
words.ex: The factory works hard to meet the demand of customers.
words.ex_cn: 工厂努力满足客户的需求。
words.en: To fulfill or satisfy the needs or requirements of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 把理论付诸实践；将理论应用于实际
words.ex: He put theory into practice by building a robot.
words.ex_cn: 他通过制作一个机器人将理论付诸实践。
words.en: To apply theoretical knowledge in a practical or real-world situation.

words.w: the responsibility for sth. falls on sb.
words.tr: 短语：某事的责任落在某人身上（表示某人须对某事负责）
words.uk: ðə ˌrɛspənˈsɪbɪlɪti fɔː ˈsʌmθɪŋ fɔːlz ɒn ˈsʌmbɒdi
words.us: ðə ˌrɛspənˈsɪbələti fɔr ˈsʌmθɪŋ fɔlz ɑn ˈsʌmˌbɑdi
words.ex: The responsibility for cleaning the room falls on me.
words.ex_cn: 打扫房间的责任落在我身上。
words.en: The phrase 'the responsibility for sth. falls on sb.' means that someone is given the duty or obligation to handle a particular task or situation.

words.w: deny sb. the freedom to do sth.
words.tr: 短语动词. 拒绝给予某人做某事的自由；剥夺某人做某事的权利
words.uk: /dɪˈnaɪ ˈsʌmbədi ðə ˈfriːdəm tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
words.us: /dɪˈnaɪ ˈsʌmbədi ðə ˈfriːdəm tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
words.ex: The law denies citizens the freedom to speak freely.
words.ex_cn: 法律剥夺了公民自由发言的自由。
words.en: To refuse to allow someone the liberty to perform a certain action.

words.w: there is no substitute for sth.
words.tr: 习语。某事物无可替代；没有什么能取代某事物
words.ex: There is no substitute for hard work.
words.ex_cn: 努力工作是无可替代的。
words.en: phrase. Nothing can replace something; something is essential and cannot be replaced by anything else.

words.tr:
n. 妥协；
v. 危及；
words.ex: They reached a compromise after hours of talk.
words.ex_cn: 经过数小时的讨论，他们达成了妥协。
words.en: A compromise is an agreement between two people or groups in which each side gives up some of the things they want so that both sides are happy at the end.

words.tr: n. 导师；顾问；
words.ex: My mentor helped me choose my career path.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮助我选择了职业道路。
words.en: A mentor is a person who gives a younger or less experienced person help and advice over a period of time, especially at work or school.

words.tr: phrase. v. 熬夜工作；开夜车
words.ex: He burns the midnight oil to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他熬夜完成作业。
words.en: If you burn the midnight oil, you stay up very late in order to study or do some other work.

words.tr: phrase. 工作保障
words.ex: He wants job security because he has a family to support.
words.ex_cn: 他想要工作保障，因为他要养家。
words.en: Job security refers to the probability that an individual will keep their job; a job with a high level of job security is one with a low risk of unemployment.

words.tr: phrase. 一种成就感；一种满足感
words.ex: He feels a sense of fulfilment after helping others.
words.ex_cn: 他在帮助别人后感到一种满足感。
words.en: A feeling of satisfaction or happiness that comes from achieving something or doing something meaningful.

words.tr: phrase. 过重的工作负担；过度的工作量
words.ex: He feels tired because of excessive workload.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作量过大而感到疲惫。
words.en: An unreasonably large amount of work assigned to a person or group, often leading to stress and reduced productivity.

words.tr: phrase. 在巨大压力下工作
words.ex: He can work under enormous stress and still do a good job.
words.ex_cn: 他能在巨大压力下工作，并且仍然做得很好。
words.en: To perform tasks or duties while experiencing a significant amount of pressure or stress.

words.w: work long hours for low pay
words.tr: phrase. 为低薪长时间工作
words.uk: wɜːk lɒŋ ˈaʊəz fɔː ləʊ peɪ
words.us: wɜːrk lɔːŋ ˈaʊərz fɔː loʊ peɪ
words.ex: He works long hours for low pay at the factory.
words.ex_cn: 他在工厂里长时间工作却赚得很少。
words.en: To work for extended periods of time while receiving minimal compensation.

words.tr: phrase. 一份要求很高的工作；需要大量精力、时间或技能的工作
words.ex: He has a demanding job that requires long hours.
words.ex_cn: 他有一份要求很高的工作，需要长时间工作。
words.en: A demanding job is one that requires a lot of time, energy, or attention because of its difficulty or the high standards expected.

words.tr: phrase. 灵活的安排；可调整的布置
words.ex: The company offers a flexible arrangement for working hours.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司提供灵活的工作时间安排。
words.en: A flexible arrangement refers to an adaptable or variable plan or agreement that can be modified according to needs or circumstances.

words.tr: phrase. 人员配备充足的；拥有足够员工的
words.ex: The hospital is well-staffed with nurses and doctors.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院有充足的护士和医生。
words.en: Having an adequate number of qualified employees to meet operational needs.

words.tr: phrase. 引起摩擦；导致矛盾或冲突
words.ex: He causes friction in the team by always arguing.
words.ex_cn: 他总是争吵，导致团队不和。
words.en: To cause friction means to create tension or conflict between people or groups.

words.tr: phrase. 由压力引发的疾病
words.ex: He got stress-induced diseases from working too hard.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太辛苦而得了压力引起的疾病。
words.en: Illnesses caused or worsened by prolonged psychological pressure.

words.tr: phrase. 职业危害；职业性风险
words.ex: Working with chemicals is an occupational hazard.
words.ex_cn: 接触化学物质是一种职业风险。
words.en: A risk inherent to a particular job or profession.

words.tr: phrase. 极其繁重的；累断腰的（指非常辛苦、耗费体力的工作）
words.ex: He does backbreaking tasks every day to support his family.
words.ex_cn: 他每天做繁重的工作来养家糊口。
words.en: Extremely physically demanding and exhausting work.

words.tr: phrase. 费力的任务；耗时费力的工作；艰苦繁重的事务
words.ex: Cleaning the house is a laborious task.
words.ex_cn: 打扫房子是一项费力的任务。
words.en: Tasks requiring sustained, tedious effort and diligence.

words.tr: v. 有；得到；吃；
words.ex: I have a book.
words.ex_cn: 我有一本书。
words.en: To possess, own, or hold something.

words.tr: phrase. 感觉不自在或不适应，好像不在自己熟悉的环境中
words.ex: He feels out of his element when talking about sports.
words.ex_cn: 当他谈论体育时，他感到不自在。
words.en: To feel uncomfortable, awkward, or out of place in a particular situation or environment.

words.tr: phrase. 不分昼夜地工作；连续不停地工作
words.ex: The nurses work around the clock to care for patients.
words.ex_cn: 护士们日夜不停地照顾病人。
words.en: Working continuously, day and night, without stopping.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人分心，使某人从某事上转移注意力
words.ex: The noise distracts him from his homework.
words.ex_cn: 噪音让他无法专心做作业。
words.en: To prevent someone from giving their full attention to something.

words.tr: phrase. 过着忙碌的生活
words.ex: He leads a busy life with work and family.
words.ex_cn: 他过着忙碌的生活，要工作又要照顾家庭。
words.en: To have a schedule or lifestyle that is filled with many activities or responsibilities, leaving little free time.

words.tr: phrase. 一份压力大且耗时的工作
words.uk: ə ˈstresful ənd ˈtaɪm kənˌsjuːmɪŋ dʒɒb
words.us: ə ˈstresful ənd ˈtaɪm kənˌsumɪŋ dʒɑːb
words.ex: He has a stressful and time-consuming job as a nurse.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名护士，工作压力大又耗时。
words.en: A job that causes significant mental or emotional pressure and requires a large amount of time.

words.tr: n. 动机；诱因；
words.ex: The bonus is an incentive to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 奖金是努力工作的动机。
words.en: Something that encourages a person to do something or to work harder.

words.tr: phrase. 激励追随者；鼓舞粉丝；激发追随者的热情
words.ex: The teacher inspires followers with her kindness.
words.ex_cn: 老师以她的善良激励追随者。
words.en: To motivate or encourage followers to take action or achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 玻璃天花板（指女性或少数群体在职业晋升中遇到的隐形障碍）
words.ex: She broke the glass ceiling in her company.
words.ex_cn: 她打破了公司里的无形晋升壁垒。
words.en: An unofficial barrier to advancement in a profession, especially affecting women and members of minorities.

words.tr: adj. 自立的；靠自己力量的
words.ex: He is self-reliant and solves his problems alone.
words.ex_cn: 他自立，自己解决自己的问题。
words.en: Someone who is self-reliant is capable of doing things and making decisions by themselves, without needing other people to help them.

words.tr: phrase. 表现出主动性；主动采取行动
words.ex: He shows initiative by helping others without being asked.
words.ex_cn: 他主动帮助别人，表现出积极性。
words.en: Display the ability to assess and initiate tasks independently without being told.

words.tr: adj. 紧握的；顽强的；坚决的；强的（记忆力）
words.ex: The child held the toy with tenacious hands.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用紧握的手抓住玩具。
words.en: If you describe someone as tenacious, you are admiring their determination to do something and their refusal to stop trying even when it is difficult.

words.tr: phrase. 遵守诺言；守信用
words.ex: He keeps his word and always does what he promises.
words.ex_cn: 他信守诺言，总是做他承诺过的事情。
words.en: To do what one has promised to do.

words.tr: adj. 实际的；脚踏实地的
words.ex: He is a down-to-earth man who helps everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个脚踏实地的人，乐于帮助每个人。
words.en: If you say that someone is down-to-earth, you approve of the fact that they concern themselves with practical things and actions, rather than with abstract theories.

words.tr: phrase. 为某事物设定基准或标准
words.ex: He set the benchmark for good sportsmanship.
words.ex_cn: 他为良好的体育精神树立了标准。
words.en: To establish a standard or point of reference for something.

words.tr: phrase. 文艺复兴时期的人；多才多艺的人
words.ex: Leonardo da Vinci was a renaissance man who painted, invented, and studied nature.
words.ex_cn: 列奥纳多·达·芬奇是一个文艺复兴时期的人，他会绘画、发明并研究自然。
words.en: A Renaissance man is a person who is skilled in many different areas of knowledge or activity, especially in the arts and sciences.

words.tr: adj. 世界知名的
words.ex: He is a world-renowned scientist.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位世界闻名的科学家。
words.en: Known and admired throughout the world; famous globally.

words.tr: n. 拼命三郎；非常积极能干的人；老手
words.ex: He is a go-getter who always finishes his work early.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个积极主动的人，总是早早完成工作。
words.en: A go-getter is someone who is very energetic, determined to be successful, and able to deal with new or difficult situations easily.

words.w: people from all walks of life
words.tr: phrase. 各行各业的人；社会各阶层人士
words.uk: ˈpiːpl frəm ɔːl wɔːks əv laɪf
words.us: ˈpiːpl frəm ɔːl wɔːks əv laɪf
words.ex: People from all walks of life came to the festival.
words.ex_cn: 来自各行各业的人都来参加了这个节日。
words.en: People from all walks of life refers to individuals from various professions, backgrounds, or social statuses.

words.w: a subject very close to one's heart
words.tr: phrase. 一个非常贴近某人内心的话题；一个对某人来说极为重要或情感上非常关切的主题
words.uk: ə ˈsʌbdʒɪkt ˈvɛri kləʊs tu wʌnz hɑːt
words.us: ə ˈsʌbdʒɛkt ˈvɛri kloʊs tu wʌnz hɑrt
words.ex: Protecting animals is a subject very close to one's heart.
words.ex_cn: 保护动物是一个非常贴近人心的话题。
words.en: A topic or issue that someone cares deeply about.

words.tr: n. 奢华；奢侈品；难得的享受；
words.ex: She bought a luxury dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件奢华的裙子。
words.en: Luxury is very great comfort, especially among beautiful and expensive surroundings.

words.w: part and parcel of being famous
words.tr: phrase. 成名过程中不可或缺的一部分；成名的必然组成部分
words.uk: pɑːt ənd ˈpɑːsl əv ˈbiːɪŋ ˈfeɪməs
words.us: pɑːrt ənd ˈpɑːrsl əv ˈbiːɪŋ ˈfeɪməs
words.ex: Being watched everywhere is part and parcel of being famous.
words.ex_cn: 到处被人关注是成名的一部分。
words.en: An essential or integral component of the experience of being famous.

words.tr: phrase. 运输基础设施；指支持交通运输系统的设施，如道路、铁路、机场、港口等
words.ex: The city built new transport infrastructure to reduce traffic.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市建造了新的交通基础设施以减少交通拥堵。
words.en: The physical networks and facilities used for moving people and goods, including roads, railways, ports, and airports.

words.tr: phrase. 交通瓶颈；指道路上因容量不足或障碍导致车流受阻的路段
words.ex: The traffic bottleneck causes long delays at rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 交通瓶颈在高峰时段导致长时间延误。
words.en: A traffic bottleneck is a section of a road or highway where the flow of traffic is significantly reduced, often causing delays and congestion.

words.tr: adj. 车辆一辆接一辆地紧密排列的，通常指交通拥堵的情况。
words.ex: The traffic was bumper-to-bumper during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段交通拥堵不堪。
words.en: Describing a situation where vehicles are closely packed together, typically in heavy traffic.

words.tr: adj. 塞紧的，拥挤不堪的 v. 塞紧，塞得透不过气( jam-pack的过去式和过去分词 )
words.ex: The bus was jam-packed with students.
words.ex_cn: 公交车里挤满了学生。
words.en: Extremely crowded or full.

words.tr: n. 汽油
words.ex: He buys petrol every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五买汽油。
words.en: A liquid obtained from petroleum, used especially as a fuel in cars.

words.tr: phrase. 耗油量
words.ex: The car has high fuel consumption.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车油耗很高。
words.en: The amount of fuel used by a vehicle or machine over a certain period or distance.

words.tr: phrase. 鲁莽驾驶；危险驾驶
words.ex: He was fined for reckless driving.
words.ex_cn: 他因危险驾驶被罚款。
words.en: Driving in a way that shows a disregard for the safety of others.

words.tr: 短语动词. 平安无事地到达某地；安全地抵达某个地方
words.ex: They walked for hours but finally got somewhere safe and sound.
words.ex_cn: 他们走了几个小时，终于安全到达了一个安全的地方。
words.en: To arrive at a place without any harm or damage.

words.tr: n. 混战；自由竞争
words.ex: The playground became a free-for-all during recess.
words.ex_cn: 课间休息时，操场变成了混乱的场面。
words.en: A free-for-all is a situation in which everyone involved can act without restriction or control, often leading to chaos or disorder.

words.tr: phrase. 猛踩刹车；急刹车
words.ex: He jammed on the brakes to avoid the dog.
words.ex_cn: 他猛踩刹车以避开那只狗。
words.en: To press the brakes of a vehicle suddenly and forcefully in order to stop quickly.

words.tr: n. 卫生；卫生学；
words.ex: Good hygiene helps prevent sickness.
words.ex_cn: 良好的卫生有助于预防疾病。
words.en: Hygiene refers to conditions and practices that help to maintain health and prevent the spread of diseases.

words.tr: adj. 有营养的；滋养的；
words.ex: Eating fruits and vegetables is nutritious.
words.ex_cn: 吃水果和蔬菜是有营养的。
words.en: Nutritious food contains substances which help your body to be healthy.

words.tr: phrase. 当季；正当时；处于旺季
words.ex: Apples are in season in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 苹果在秋天是当季的。
words.en: If a fruit or vegetable is in season, it is the time of year when it is ready for eating and is widely available.

words.tr: phrase. 速冻食品
words.ex: He bought some frozen food from the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 他从超市买了些速冻食品。
words.en: Frozen food refers to food that has been subjected to rapid freezing and is kept frozen until use, preserving it from the time of preparation to the time of consumption.

words.tr: phrase. 健康的饮食；有益健康的膳食
words.ex: Eating a wholesome diet helps you stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 吃健康的饮食有助于你保持健康。
words.en: A wholesome diet refers to a way of eating that contributes to overall health and well-being, typically including a variety of nutrients from different food groups.

words.tr: phrase. 减少；节省
words.ex: He wants to cut down on sugar to be healthier.
words.ex_cn: 他想减少糖的摄入来更健康。
words.en: To reduce the amount or number of something.

words.tr: phrase. 沉迷于快餐的人；快餐成瘾者
words.ex: He is a fast food junkie who eats burgers every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是个快餐迷，每天都吃汉堡。
words.en: A person who is very fond of or addicted to fast food.

words.tr: phrase. 饮食习惯；指个人或群体在日常饮食中的偏好和规律
words.ex: His dietary habits changed after he got sick.
words.ex_cn: 他生病后，饮食习惯发生了变化。
words.en: Dietary habits are the regular patterns of eating and drinking that a person or group follows.

words.tr: phrase. 微量元素；痕量元素（指生物体或物质中含量极微但具有重要生理或化学作用的元素）
words.ex: Plants need trace elements to grow well.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要微量元素才能良好生长。
words.en: Trace elements are minerals required by the body in very small amounts for normal physiological functions.

words.tr: phrase. 爱吃甜品
words.ex: She has a sweet tooth and eats candy every day.
words.ex_cn: 她爱吃甜食，每天都要吃糖果。
words.en: If you have a sweet tooth, you like eating sweet foods, especially sweets and chocolate.

words.tr: adj. 令人垂涎的; 非常好吃的
words.ex: The smell of the cookies is mouth-watering.
words.ex_cn: 饼干的香味令人垂涎。
words.en: If you describe food as mouth-watering, you mean that it looks or smells extremely delicious.

words.tr: phrase. 弹出式广告窗口；网页中自动弹出的小广告框
words.ex: The website showed many pop-up advertising windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个网站显示了许多弹出式广告窗口。
words.en: Pop-up advertising windows are small, unsolicited browser windows that appear suddenly to display advertisements.

words.tr: phrase. +adj. 被密集地宣传的；被高强度打广告的
words.ex: The product is intensively advertised on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这个产品在电视上被大力宣传。
words.en: Advertised in a very thorough and concentrated manner.

words.tr: phrase. 高峰时间
words.ex: The bus is crowded during peak time.
words.ex_cn: 在高峰期，公交车很拥挤。
words.en: The period during which the highest levels of activity or demand occur.

words.tr: phrase. v. 紧紧地盯着某物（通常指电视、书本或屏幕等）；全神贯注于某事物
words.ex: The boy is glued to his video game.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩一直盯着他的电子游戏。
words.en: If you say that someone is glued to something, you mean that they are giving it all their attention because they find it very interesting or exciting.

words.tr: phrase. 破坏某人的乐趣
words.ex: Don't destroy one's fun with bad news.
words.ex_cn: 不要用坏消息破坏别人的乐趣。
words.en: To ruin or spoil someone's enjoyment or pleasure.

words.tr: phrase. 老生常谈的主题；被过度使用而显得陈旧的题材
words.ex: The movie uses well-worn themes like love and betrayal.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影使用了诸如爱情和背叛这样的老套主题。
words.en: Overused ideas or topics that have lost their original impact.

words.tr: phrase. 时事；当前发生的重大事件
words.ex: He reads the newspaper to learn about current affairs.
words.ex_cn: 他读报纸来了解时事。
words.en: Current affairs are events of political or social importance and interest happening in the world at the present time.

words.tr: phrase. 有新闻价值的事件；值得报道的事件
words.ex: The fire was a newsworthy event.
words.ex_cn: 这场火灾是一起值得报道的事件。
words.en: An event considered important enough to be reported by news media.

words.tr: phrase. 歪曲事实；篡改真相
words.ex: He tried to distort the truth to avoid punishment.
words.ex_cn: 他试图歪曲事实以避免惩罚。
words.en: To distort the truth means to misrepresent or alter the facts in a way that is misleading or false.

words.tr:
n. 审查员；检查员
v. 检查；审查
words.ex: The censor removed the bad words from the movie.
words.ex_cn: 审查员从电影中删除了粗俗用语。
words.en: A censor is a person who supervises conduct and morals: in particular, one who examines books, films, or other material for objectionable matter.

words.tr: phrase. 公众人物；知名人士
words.ex: Public figures often face media attention.
words.ex_cn: 公众人物经常面临媒体的关注。
words.en: Public figures are individuals who have a certain degree of fame and influence in society, often due to their profession, achievements, or public roles.

words.tr: phrase. 法庭媒体曝光；指法院案件通过媒体向公众传播和报道的现象
words.ex: The celebrity sought to avoid court media publicity after the trial.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人试图在审判后避免法庭媒体曝光。
words.en: The coverage and reporting of court proceedings by the media, aimed at informing the public but sometimes influencing perceptions and outcomes.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 富有魅力的名人； glamorous 指极具吸引力或光鲜亮丽的，celebrity 指著名人物或明星，合起来形容一位外表迷人、备受瞩目的公众人物
words.ex: The glamorous celebrity smiled at the fans.
words.ex_cn: 那位光彩夺目的名人向粉丝微笑。
words.en: A glamorous celebrity is a famous person who is very attractive and stylish.

words.tr: v. 夸张；夸大；
words.ex: He exaggerates his achievements to impress others.
words.ex_cn: 他夸张自己的成就来给别人留下印象。
words.en: If you exaggerate, you indicate that something is, for example, worse or more important than it really is.

words.tr: phrase. 逃避现实；摆脱现实生活的压力或困扰
words.ex: He watches movies to escape reality.
words.ex_cn: 他看电影来逃避现实。
words.en: To escape reality means to avoid facing the real world, often by engaging in activities that provide a distraction from real-life problems or responsibilities.

words.tr:
n. 全体演员；
v. 投掷；扔；投射；
words.ex: The cast of the play performed very well.
words.ex_cn: 这部剧的全体演员表演得非常好。
words.en: To cast something means to throw it forcefully in a particular direction.

words.tr: phrase. 变得广泛可用；变得普及并容易获得
words.ex: Solar panels become widely available in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能电池板在许多国家变得广泛可用。
words.en: To become accessible to the general public on a large scale.

words.tr: phrase. 开创先河；取得突破性进展；开辟新领域
words.ex: The scientist's research breaks new ground in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家的研究在医学上开辟了新领域。
words.en: To do something innovative that has not been done before.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 热烈欢迎某事；张开双臂迎接某事
words.ex: They welcomed the new student with open arms.
words.ex_cn: 他们热情地欢迎了这位新生。
words.en: Receive someone or something with great enthusiasm and pleasure.

words.tr: phrase. 遗传工程；基因工程
words.ex: Scientists use genetic engineering to change plant genes.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用基因工程来改变植物的基因。
words.en: The deliberate modification of the characteristics of an organism by manipulating its genetic material.

words.tr: phrase. 云计算
words.ex: He uses cloud computing to store his files.
words.ex_cn: 他使用云计算来存储文件。
words.en: Cloud computing is the delivery of different services through the Internet, including data storage, servers, databases, networking, and software.

words.tr: phrase. 通信设备；通讯器材
words.ex: The school bought new communications equipment for the office.
words.ex_cn: 学校为办公室购买了新的通信设备。
words.en: Devices and systems used for transmitting and receiving information, such as radios or telephones.

words.tr: phrase. 载人任务；载人航天任务
words.ex: The country plans a manned mission to the moon next year.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家计划明年执行一次载人登月任务。
words.en: A manned mission is a spaceflight mission in which humans are aboard the spacecraft.

words.tr: phrase. 满足人类的好奇心
words.ex: The telescope helps to satisfy human curiosity about space.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜帮助满足人类对太空的好奇心。
words.en: To fulfill or answer the desire to learn or know about something.

words.tr: phrase. 社交网络网站；用于人际互动与信息分享的在线平台
words.ex: He uses social networking websites to talk with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他使用社交网站和朋友聊天。
words.en: Websites that allow people to create a public profile and interact with other users on the website.

words.tr: phrase. 电子邮件欺诈；通过电子邮件进行的诈骗行为
words.ex: He lost money because of e-mail fraud.
words.ex_cn: 他因为电子邮件诈骗而损失了钱。
words.en: The use of electronic mail to deceive or defraud individuals, often for financial gain.

words.tr: phrase. 人工智能
words.ex: He is learning artificial intelligence at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习人工智能。
words.en: Artificial intelligence refers to the simulation of human intelligence in machines that are programmed to think like humans and mimic their actions.

words.tr: n. 超导体；超导电体
words.ex: The superconductor carries electricity without losing energy.
words.ex_cn: 超导体在传输电力时不会损失能量。
words.en: A superconductor is a material that can conduct electricity without resistance when it is cooled below a certain temperature.

words.tr: adj. 机械化的；用机械操作的；
words.ex: The farm became mechanised with new tractors.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场通过新拖拉机实现了机械化。
words.en: Equipped with or involving machinery, especially to replace or enhance human or animal labor.

words.tr: phrase. 硅谷（美国加利福尼亚州的一个地区，以高科技产业和创新公司聚集闻名）
words.ex: He works in Silicon Valley as a software engineer.
words.ex_cn: 他在硅谷做软件工程师。
words.en: A region in California, USA, known for its high technology industry and innovation.

words.tr: phrase. 加快……的节奏或速度
words.ex: He tried to speed up the pace of his walking.
words.ex_cn: 他试图加快走路的速度。
words.en: To increase the rate or speed at which something happens or is done.

words.tr: phrase. 虚拟现实
words.ex: He is wearing a headset to experience virtual reality.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着头盔体验虚拟现实。
words.en: Virtual reality is an artificial environment that is created with software and presented to the user in such a way that the user suspends belief and accepts it as a real environment.

words.tr: 短语动词. 使摆脱某事物；从某事物中获得解放
words.ex: The new law will bring liberation from unfair taxes.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律将带来从不公平税收中的解放。
words.en: To free someone or something from a particular constraint or oppression.

words.tr: phrase. 可以想象的是……；可以想见的是……
words.ex: It is conceivable that he forgot the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 可以想象的是，他忘记了会议。
words.en: It is possible to imagine or think that...

words.w: some scientific evidence has emerged to the contrary.
words.tr: 短语。一些科学证据已经出现，与之相反（表明先前的观点或结论不成立）
words.ex: Some scientific evidence has emerged to the contrary.
words.ex_cn: 一些科学证据反而出现了。
words.en: Some factual information from scientific study has been found that opposes a previous idea.

words.tr: phrase. 社交动物；喜欢与人交往的人
words.ex: Humans are social creatures.
words.ex_cn: 人类是社会性生物。
words.en: An animal or person that lives and interacts in groups, relying on social contact.

words.tr: phrase. 通信手段；交流方式；沟通工具
words.ex: Phones and emails are means of communication.
words.ex_cn: 电话和电子邮件是沟通的方式。
words.en: Means of communication refers to the methods or systems used for exchanging information or messages between people or groups.

words.tr: phrase. 充分参与；完全投入到
words.ex: He wants to participate fully in the class discussion.
words.ex_cn: 他想完全参与课堂讨论。
words.en: To take part in something completely or to the fullest extent.

words.tr: phrase. 志趣相投的人；心灵相通的人；知己
words.ex: He is a kindred spirit who loves the same books as me.
words.ex_cn: 他是个志同道合的人，和我一样喜欢同样的书。
words.en: A person whose interests or attitudes are similar to one's own.

words.tr: 短语. 第一印象最持久
words.ex: First impressions are most lasting.
words.ex_cn: 第一印象最持久。
words.en: The first impressions someone makes are likely to be remembered the longest.

words.tr: phrase. 观点一致；合拍
words.ex: They are on the same wavelength and understand each other easily.
words.ex_cn: 他们想法一致，很容易理解对方。
words.en: If two people are on the same wavelength, they understand each other well because they share the same attitudes, interests, and opinions.

words.tr: phrase. 只在顺境时才做朋友的人；不能共患难的朋友
words.ex: He is a fair-weather friend who leaves when things get hard.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个只在顺境时才陪伴的朋友，一有困难就离开。
words.en: A person who is only supportive or friendly in times of success or good fortune.

words.w: console sb. at times of sorrow
words.tr: phrase. 在悲伤时刻安慰某人
words.ex: Her friends console her at times of sorrow.
words.ex_cn: 朋友们在她悲伤时安慰她。
words.en: To offer sympathy and comfort to someone during a period of grief or sadness.

words.w: compete on a level playing field
words.tr: 短语. 在公平的条件下竞争；在平等的竞争环境中较量
words.uk: kəmˈpiːt ɒn ə ˈlev(ə)l ˈpleɪɪŋ fiːld
words.us: kəmˈpiːt ɑːn ə ˈlev(ə)l ˈpleɪɪŋ fiːld
words.ex: All companies should compete on a level playing field.
words.ex_cn: 所有公司都应在公平的环境中竞争。
words.en: To compete in a situation where everyone has an equal chance of winning or succeeding.

words.tr: phrase. v. 变得过于兴奋或激动而失去控制；忘乎所以；得意忘形
words.ex: He got carried away with the game and forgot to eat dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他玩游戏玩得忘了吃晚饭。
words.en: If you get carried away, you are so excited or involved in something that you do something hasty or foolish.

words.tr: v. 爱慕；敬慕；崇拜
words.ex: She adores her little brother.
words.ex_cn: 她非常喜爱她的弟弟。
words.en: If you adore someone, you feel great love and admiration for them.

words.tr: 短语动词. 渴望某物；对某物怀有强烈的向往或渴望
words.ex: He has a yearning for freedom.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望自由。
words.en: To have a strong desire or longing for something.

words.tr: phrase. 喜欢
words.ex: He is fond of eating apples.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃什么苹果。
words.en: If you are fond of someone or something, you feel affection for them or like them.

words.tr: adj. 不感兴趣的；不关心的；
words.ex: He was indifferent to the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影不感兴趣。
words.en: If you accuse someone of being indifferent to something, you mean that they have a complete lack of interest in it.

words.tr: v. 厌恶；憎恶
words.ex: I loathe waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 我讨厌早起。
words.en: If you loathe something or someone, you dislike them very much.

words.w: have one's heart set on sth.
words.tr: phrase. 一心想要某物；决心要得到某物
words.uk: hæv wʌnz hɑːt set ɒn ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: hæv wʌnz hɑːrt set ɑːn ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: He has his heart set on becoming a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他一心想要当医生。
words.en: To be determined to get something or to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 悬而未决的；未确定的；不确定的
words.ex: The plans are up in the air.
words.ex_cn: 计划还未确定。
words.en: If a matter is up in the air, it is uncertain, often because other matters have to be decided first.

words.tr: phrase. 还清；得到回报；取得成功
words.ex: He worked hard and finally paid off his debt.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，终于还清了债务。
words.en: If something you have done pays off, it is successful or brings a good result.

words.tr: phrase. 极好的机会；千载难逢的良机
words.ex: He got a golden opportunity to work abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了一个去国外工作的绝佳机会。
words.en: A golden opportunity is a very good chance to do or achieve something that you have wanted for a long time.

words.tr: phrase. (事情)付诸东流，白白浪费，化为乌有
words.ex: All his hard work went down the drain when he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了工作，所有的努力都白费了。
words.en: If something goes down the drain, it is wasted or fails to achieve anything.

words.tr: phrase. 尽力；努力；使自己付出努力
words.ex: He exerts himself to finish the job on time.
words.ex_cn: 他努力按时完成工作。
words.en: To exert oneself means to make a physical or mental effort.

words.tr: phrase. 实现；成功；结出果实（指计划、想法等最终得以实现）
words.ex: Her dream to open a small bakery came to fruition last year.
words.ex_cn: 她开一家小面包店的梦想去年实现了。
words.en: If a plan or project comes to fruition, it is successfully completed after a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 链条中最薄弱的一环；比喻体系或团队中最脆弱或最不可靠的部分
words.ex: The weak link in the chain broke easily.
words.ex_cn: 链条中最弱的一环很容易就断了。
words.en: A weak link in the chain refers to the most vulnerable or least reliable part of a system or group, which can cause the entire system or group to fail if it fails.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对双方都有利或都有害；两面都有影响
words.ex: This rule can cut both ways: it helps some people but hurts others.
words.ex_cn: 这个规则可能两面都有影响：它帮助了一些人，但也伤害了其他人。
words.en: If something cuts both ways, it has both positive and negative effects or can be interpreted in two different ways.

words.tr: phrase. 灾难的根源；导致失败的做法；祸因
words.ex: The mix of bad weather and poor planning is a recipe for disaster.
words.ex_cn: 糟糕的天气和糟糕的计划结合在一起，注定会酿成灾难。
words.en: A situation or course of action that is likely to lead to a very bad outcome.

words.tr: n. 传下来的衣物；二手衣物
words.ex: He wears hand-me-downs from his older brother.
words.ex_cn: 他穿他哥哥传下来的衣服。
words.en: Clothes or other items that have been passed down from one person to another, typically within a family.

words.tr: 短语动词. 穿着得体以获得成功，指通过穿着正式或专业的服装来提升个人形象和职业成就
words.ex: You should dress for success when going to a job interview.
words.ex_cn: 去参加工作面试时，你应该穿得得体以取得成功。
words.en: To dress in a way that is intended to create a positive impression and help achieve success, especially in a professional context.

words.tr: phrase. 无可挑剔的穿衣品味；衣着品味极佳
words.ex: She has impeccable taste in clothing.
words.ex_cn: 她在服装上有极佳的品味。
words.en: Impeccable taste in clothing refers to an exceptional and flawless sense of style and fashion in dressing.

words.tr: phrase. 人靠衣装；衣冠决定人的形象
words.ex: He wears a suit to work, because clothes make the man.
words.ex_cn: 他上班穿西装，因为人靠衣装。
words.en: The idea that a person's appearance and clothing influence how others perceive their character or status.

words.tr: adj. 赶时髦的
words.ex: She is fashion-conscious and always wears trendy clothes.
words.ex_cn: 她很注重时尚，总是穿流行的衣服。
words.en: Someone who is fashion-conscious is very interested in fashion and wants to wear the latest styles.

words.tr: phrase. 透气的衣物；指能让空气和湿气通过的服装材料，常用于运动服或户外服装
words.ex: He wears breathable clothing to stay cool.
words.ex_cn: 他穿透气的衣服来保持凉爽。
words.en: Clothing that allows air to pass through it, making it comfortable to wear, especially in hot weather or during physical activity.

words.tr: phrase. 一种涉及多种感官的体验；多感官体验
words.ex: The museum offers a multisensory experience for children.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆为孩子们提供了一种多感官体验。
words.en: An experience that involves multiple senses simultaneously, designed to engage participants more fully than a single-sense experience.

words.tr: n. 有读写能力；识字；
words.ex: Children need literacy to read books and write letters.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们需要有读写能力才能读书和写信。
words.en: Literacy is the ability to read and write.

words.tr: phrase. 潦草的笔迹；凌乱的字迹
words.ex: His messy handwriting makes it hard to read the note.
words.ex_cn: 他凌乱的字迹让这张便条很难读懂。
words.en: Handwriting that is untidy and difficult to read.

words.tr: phrase. 有声读物；音频书
words.ex: He listens to an audio book on his way to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班路上听有声书。
words.en: An audio book is a recording of a book or other work being read out loud. A reading of the complete text is described as 'unabridged', while readings of a shorter version are 'abridged'.

words.tr: phrase. 有声读物；录音书（通常为视障人士或阅读困难者提供）
words.ex: He listens to a talking book before sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他睡觉前听有声书。
words.en: A talking book is a recording of a book being read aloud, often used by people who are blind or have difficulty reading.

words.tr: phrase. 可用收益；可支配收入；税后收入
words.ex: He uses his disposable income to buy books.
words.ex_cn: 他用可支配收入买书。
words.en: Disposable income is the amount of money that households have available for spending and saving after income taxes have been accounted for.

words.tr: adj. 经济的；节俭的；
words.ex: This car is economical because it uses little fuel.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车很经济，因为它耗油少。
words.en: Using money, resources, or time in a careful and effective way.

words.tr: phrase. 收入来源
words.ex: Her small bakery is a source of income.
words.ex_cn: 她的小面包店是一个收入来源。
words.en: A means of earning money to support oneself.

words.tr: phrase. 使收支相抵；勉强维持生计；量入为出
words.ex: He works two jobs to make ends meet.
words.ex_cn: 他做两份工作来维持生计。
words.en: To have enough money to pay for the things that you need.

words.tr: phrase. 生活费；生活费用
words.ex: The cost of living in New York is very high.
words.ex_cn: 纽约的生活成本很高。
words.en: The amount of money that is needed to pay for basic needs such as food, housing, and clothes in a particular place.

words.tr: phrase. 让某人花费一大笔钱；代价高昂
words.ex: The new car cost him a fortune.
words.ex_cn: 这辆新车花了他的巨额钱款。
words.en: To require someone to spend a large amount of money.

words.tr: phrase. 富人与穷人；有产者与无产者（常用于描述社会经济地位的两极分化）
words.ex: The haves and the have-nots often live in different neighborhoods.
words.ex_cn: 有产者和无产者常常住在不同的社区。
words.en: The phrase 'the haves and the have-nots' refers to the division between people who are wealthy and those who are not.

words.tr: phrase. 地位象征；表示社会地位的标志
words.ex: He bought a luxury car as a status symbol.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一辆豪华车作为身份的象征。
words.en: An object or possession that signifies wealth or high social standing.

words.tr: phrase. 贪得的；渴望获得的；有占有欲的
words.ex: He is acquisitive and always wants more things.
words.ex_cn: 他很贪得无厌，总是想要更多东西。
words.en: Wanting to have and keep a lot of possessions, especially in a way that seems selfish or greedy.

words.tr: phrase. 勒紧裤腰带；节衣缩食，尤指因经济困难而减少开支
words.ex: When money is low, we must tighten our belt.
words.ex_cn: 当钱不够时，我们必须勒紧裤腰带。
words.en: To reduce one's spending or live more frugally, especially in response to financial difficulties.

words.tr: phrase. 负担不起某物；无法承受某事
words.ex: He cannot afford a new car.
words.ex_cn: 他买不起一辆新车。
words.en: If you cannot afford something, you do not have enough money to pay for it.

words.tr: phrase. 非常便宜的；廉价得惊人
words.ex: This phone is dirt-cheap at the market.
words.ex_cn: 这手机在市场上便宜得要命。
words.en: extremely inexpensive

words.tr: 短语动词. 去疯狂购物；进行一次购物狂欢
words.ex: She went on a shopping spree last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 她上个周末疯狂购物了一番。
words.en: To go on a shopping spree means to shop excessively and often impulsively, typically in a short period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 记录；掌握……的动态；了解……的情况；跟踪某事
words.ex: I keep track of my expenses every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天记录我的开销。
words.en: To keep track of something means to continue to be informed or know about it, or to record it.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏；不足；达不到（目标）；不符合
words.ex: They fall short of their goal every time.
words.ex_cn: 他们每次都没能达到目标。
words.en: To fail to reach a desired standard, level, or amount.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对这个价格犹豫不决；因这个价格而退缩
words.ex: He balks at this price because it is too high for him.
words.ex_cn: 他嫌这个价格太高，所以犹豫了。
words.en: To hesitate or be unwilling to accept or agree to a price.

words.tr: v. 觊觎；垂涎；贪图
words.ex: He covets his neighbor's car.
words.ex_cn: 他垂涎邻居的车。
words.en: If you covet something, you have a very strong desire to possess it, especially something that belongs to someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 财务支持；经济援助
words.ex: He got financial support from his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他从父母那里获得了经济支持。
words.en: Financial support refers to the provision of money or resources to help someone or something, especially in the context of education, business, or personal needs.

words.tr: phrase. （在物质或社会地位上）与邻居或他人攀比；赶时髦
words.ex: They buy a new car every year just to keep up with the Joneses.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年买一辆新车，只是为了和邻居攀比。
words.en: To strive to match or surpass one's neighbors or peers in terms of material possessions or social status.

words.tr: phrase. 能够唱歌不走调；能准确地唱出曲调
words.ex: He cannot carry a tune.
words.ex_cn: 他不会唱歌。
words.en: To be able to sing in tune or to sing accurately in pitch.

words.tr: phrase. 露天音乐会；户外音乐会
words.ex: They enjoyed an open-air concert under the stars.
words.ex_cn: 他们在星空下享受了一场露天音乐会。
words.en: An open-air concert is a musical performance that takes place outdoors, often in a park or other natural setting.

words.tr: phrase. 交响乐团
words.ex: The symphony orchestra played loudly at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 交响乐团在音乐会上大声演奏。
words.en: A symphony orchestra is a large orchestra that plays classical music and is led by a conductor.

words.tr: phrase. 充满…的；弥漫着…的；被…浸染的
words.ex: The room was suffused with sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 房间里洒满了阳光。
words.en: To be filled or spread throughout with a quality, emotion, or light.

words.tr: n. 电台或电视台的播放
words.ex: The song gets a lot of airplay on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在广播中播放很多。
words.en: The broadcasting of songs or programs on radio or television.

words.tr: phrase. 原声音乐；不使用电子扩音或电子乐器的音乐，通常指用原声乐器演奏的音乐
words.ex: He plays acoustic music on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末演奏原声音乐。
words.en: Music that is produced by acoustic instruments without electronic amplification.

words.tr: phrase. 流行音乐排行榜
words.ex: The song reached number one on the pop chart.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌登上了流行音乐排行榜榜首。
words.en: A list of the most popular songs or albums at a particular time, typically based on sales or radio play.

words.tr: adj. 最畅销的；最红的
words.ex: This book is the best-selling novel this year.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是今年最畅销的小说。
words.en: A best-selling product or book is one that many people buy.

words.tr: n. 畅销书；畅销货
words.ex: This book is a best-seller in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在许多国家都是畅销书。
words.en: A best-seller is a book or other product that sells in very large numbers.

words.tr: phrase. 非常成功的作品（尤指歌曲、电影或戏剧）；大热门
words.ex: The new movie is a smash hit.
words.ex_cn: 这部新电影是一部大卖的影片。
words.en: A smash hit is something, especially a film, play, or song, that is extremely successful and popular.

words.tr: n. （外出）度假者
words.ex: The holidaymaker took photos at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 这位度假者在海滩上拍照。
words.en: A holidaymaker is someone who is on holiday at a particular place.

words.tr: n. 背包客
words.ex: The backpacker walked through the mountains with a big bag.
words.ex_cn: 那个背包客背着一个大包穿越了山脉。
words.en: A backpacker is someone who travels or hikes carrying their belongings in a backpack.

words.tr: phrase. 旅行社
words.ex: He booked his flight through a travel agency.
words.ex_cn: 他通过一家旅行社预订了航班。
words.en: A travel agency is a business that helps people plan and book trips and vacations.

words.tr: phrase. 旺季
words.ex: Tourists visit the beach in peak season.
words.ex_cn: 游客在旺季去海滩。
words.en: The period of the year when demand for a particular product or service is at its highest.

words.tr: phrase. 旺季；旅游高峰季节
words.ex: Tourists visit the beach in high season.
words.ex_cn: 游客在旺季去海滩。
words.en: The period of the year when a particular place is most popular with tourists and prices are at their highest.

words.tr: phrase. 喷气式客机
words.ex: The jet airliner flew high above the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 喷气式客机在云层上方飞行。
words.en: A jet airliner is a large aircraft powered by jet engines, designed to carry passengers on commercial flights.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人变得更加宽容和心胸开阔
words.uk: meɪk sə ˈtɒlərənt ənd ˈəʊpən ˈmaɪnd
words.us: meɪk sə ˈtɑːlərənt ənd ˈoʊpən ˈmaɪnd
words.ex: Traveling makes her more tolerant and open-minded.
words.ex_cn: 旅行让她变得更宽容和开放。
words.en: To help someone become more accepting of different ideas or people.

words.tr: phrase. 消除先入之见；去除偏见或预先形成的观念
words.ex: Try to eliminate preconceptions when you meet new people.
words.ex_cn: 当你遇见新人时，试着消除先入之见。
words.en: To remove or get rid of preconceived ideas or opinions.

words.tr: phrase. 缓解紧张；减轻压力
words.ex: She sings to ease tension after work.
words.ex_cn: 她唱歌来缓解工作后的紧张。
words.en: Reduce feelings of hostility or nervousness between people or in a situation.

words.tr: 短语动词. 产生税收收入
words.ex: The new store will generate tax revenue for the city.
words.ex_cn: 这家新商店将为城市产生税收收入。
words.en: Produce income for the government through taxes.

words.tr: phrase. 游览胜地
words.ex: The Great Wall is a famous tourist attraction.
words.ex_cn: 长城是一个著名的游览胜地。
words.en: A place of interest where tourists visit, typically for its inherent or exhibited natural or cultural value, historical significance, natural or built beauty, offering leisure, adventure, and amusement.

words.tr: 短语动词. 出发；上路；开始旅行
words.ex: He hit the road early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早上路以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to leave a place to go somewhere else.

words.tr: phrase. 离开常规路线；探索人迹罕至之地；尝试非传统或冒险的事物
words.ex: They decided to venture off the beaten path to find a quiet beach.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定离开常规路线，去找一个安静的海滩。
words.en: To take a risk by doing something different or unusual, especially in travel or exploration.

words.tr: n. 路线；
words.ex: We planned our itinerary before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们在旅行前规划了路线。
words.en: An itinerary is a plan of a journey, including the route and the places that you will visit.

words.tr: phrase. 剧烈的运动；需要大量体力的体育活动
words.ex: He avoids strenuous sports because he has a weak heart.
words.ex_cn: 他避免剧烈运动，因为他心脏不好。
words.en: Requiring great physical effort and exertion; demanding sports.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的体育精神；指在比赛中表现出尊重、公平、谦虚和礼貌的态度
words.ex: He showed good sportsmanship after losing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在输掉比赛后展现了良好的体育精神。
words.en: Good sportsmanship refers to the ethical, appropriate, and polite behavior exhibited by participants in sports or other competitive activities.

words.tr: phrase. 获得知识；学习知识
words.ex: He wants to acquire knowledge by reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他想通过读书来获取知识。
words.en: To gain information, understanding, or skill through study, experience, or being taught.

words.tr: phrase. 获得一项技能
words.ex: He can acquire a skill by practicing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他可以通过每天练习来掌握一项技能。
words.en: Gain or develop a particular ability through learning or experience.

words.w: have the knack of doing sth.
words.tr: 短语动词. 擅长做某事；有做某事的诀窍
words.ex: He has the knack of solving math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他有快速解决数学问题的天赋。
words.en: To have a natural ability or skill in doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 对某事了如指掌；对某事物非常熟悉
words.ex: He knows the city inside out.
words.ex_cn: 他对这座城市了如指掌。
words.en: To know something inside out means to be completely familiar with it, understanding every detail.

words.tr: adj. 生锈的；
words.ex: The old bike has a rusty chain.
words.ex_cn: 这辆旧自行车的链条生锈了。
words.en: If something is rusty, it is covered with rust or has become less good because it has not been used for a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 擅长某事的；在某方面熟练的
words.ex: He is adept at solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长解决数学问题。
words.en: To be highly skilled or proficient in a particular activity or subject.

words.tr: phrase. 把某人当作实验对象（尤指用于医学或科学试验）
words.uk: juːz ˈsʌmbɒdi æz ə ˈɡɪni pɪɡ
words.us: juːz ˈsʌmbɑːdi æz ə ˈɡɪni pɪɡ
words.ex: They used him as a guinea pig for the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他们把他当作新药的试验对象。
words.en: To use someone as a guinea pig means to use them as a subject in an experiment or test, often without their full consent or understanding.

words.tr: phrase. 守法公民；遵纪守法的市民
words.ex: Law-abiding citizens follow the rules and pay their taxes.
words.ex_cn: 守法公民遵守规则并缴税。
words.en: People who obey the laws of the land.

words.tr: phrase. 通过新立法；使新的法律法规获得通过
words.ex: The government will pass new legislation next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将通过新法律。
words.en: To enact a new law or statute through a formal legislative process.

words.tr: phrase. 被引诱去做某事；受诱惑而陷入
words.ex: He was tempted into buying a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 他被诱使买了一部新手机。
words.en: To be strongly drawn or persuaded to do something, often wrongly.

words.tr: phrase. 职业罪犯；惯犯
words.ex: He is a career criminal who stole many times.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名惯犯，多次行窃。
words.en: A person who makes a living by committing crimes, often repeatedly and over a long period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止某人做某事；使某人打消做某事的念头
words.ex: The rain deterred him from going out.
words.ex_cn: 下雨阻止了他出去。
words.en: To prevent someone from doing something by making them realize the difficulties or unpleasant consequences of their actions.

words.tr:
v. 定罪；宣判有罪
n. 罪犯；囚犯
words.ex: The court convicted him of theft.
words.ex_cn: 法院判定他犯有盗窃罪。
words.en: If someone is convicted of a crime, they are found guilty of that crime in a court of law.

words.tr: phrase. 已经大量繁殖；已经迅速扩散；已经激增
words.ex: Smartphones have proliferated in recent years.
words.ex_cn: 近年来，智能手机大量增加。
words.en: To increase rapidly in number or spread widely.

words.tr: n. 残忍；暴行；
words.ex: The movie shows the brutality of war.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了战争的残忍。
words.en: Brutality is cruel and violent behavior, or a cruel and violent act.

words.tr: phrase. 完全无法自拔地沉迷于；对……上瘾到无药可救的程度
words.ex: He is hopelessly addicted to video games.
words.ex_cn: 他对电子游戏上瘾得无法自拔。
words.en: To be unable to stop doing or using something, especially something harmful.

words.tr: phrase. 网络诈骗；线上欺诈
words.ex: He lost money to online fraud last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月在网上诈骗中损失了钱。
words.en: Deception or cheating that is carried out via the internet.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人对社会变得冷酷或敌对
words.ex: His parents tried to harden him against society.
words.ex_cn: 他的父母试图让他对社会变得冷漠。
words.en: To make someone less sensitive or more tough in their attitudes towards society, often as a result of negative experiences.

words.tr: phrase. 接受审判；出庭受审
words.ex: He will stand trial for stealing a car.
words.ex_cn: 他将因偷车受审。
words.en: To undergo a judicial examination and determination of issues between parties by a court of law.

words.tr: phrase. 惯犯；累犯
words.ex: He is a repeat offender who stole again last month.
words.ex_cn: 他是个惯犯，上个月又偷了。
words.en: A repeat offender is a person who has been convicted of a crime on more than one occasion.

words.tr: n. 扒手；小偷
words.ex: The pickpocket stole his wallet on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 小偷在公交车上偷了他的钱包。
words.en: A pickpocket is a person who steals things from people's pockets or bags in public places.

words.tr: phrase. 一场骗局；欺诈行为
words.ex: He lost money because of a scam.
words.ex_cn: 他因为一个骗局损失了钱。
words.en: A dishonest scheme or fraud designed to cheat someone.

words.tr: phrase. v. 对某事采取严厉措施；严厉打击
words.ex: The government will crack down on illegal selling.
words.ex_cn: 政府将严厉打击非法销售。
words.en: To take severe measures against something in order to stop or prevent it.

words.tr: phrase. 宁静的与安详的；形容环境或心境平和、无扰、祥和
words.ex: The lake is tranquil and serene at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 日出时，湖面宁静而平和。
words.en: Free from disturbance; calm and peaceful.

words.tr: phrase. 缓解压力；减轻紧张
words.ex: Listening to music can relieve stress.
words.ex_cn: 听音乐可以缓解压力。
words.en: To reduce or alleviate the feeling of stress or tension.

words.tr: phrase. 遍布；点缀着
words.ex: The sky is dotted with stars.
words.ex_cn: 天空布满了星星。
words.en: To be scattered or sprinkled with something, typically in a way that creates a pattern or design.

words.tr: phrase. 蜿蜒的小路；曲折的路径
words.ex: The children walked along the winding paths in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里沿着蜿蜒的小路行走。
words.en: Paths that twist and turn, often in a serpentine or meandering manner.

words.tr: adj. 彩虹色的；色彩斑斓的
words.ex: The soap bubble is iridescent in the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 肥皂泡在阳光下呈现出彩虹色。
words.en: Showing luminous colors that seem to change when seen from different angles.

words.tr: adj. 令人敬畏的；令人惊叹的
words.ex: The mountain view is awe-inspiring.
words.ex_cn: 山景令人敬畏。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as awe-inspiring, you are emphasizing that you think that they are remarkable and amazing, although sometimes rather frightening.

words.tr: phrase. 落叶树（指在干旱或寒冷季节落叶的树木）
words.ex: The deciduous trees lose their leaves in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 落叶树在秋天会掉叶子。
words.en: Deciduous trees are trees that shed their leaves annually, typically in the autumn.

words.tr: n. 花束；（酒等的）芳香
words.ex: She bought a bouquet of flowers for her mom.
words.ex_cn: 她为妈妈买了一束花。
words.en: A bouquet is a bunch of flowers that is attractively arranged, especially one that is given to someone as a present.

words.tr: n. 叶子（总称）；
words.ex: The trees showed bright foliage in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 秋天时，树木呈现出鲜艳的叶子。
words.en: The leaves of a plant or tree, or the leaves on trees and plants collectively.

words.tr: n. 野营地；露营场所
words.ex: We set up our tent at the campground.
words.ex_cn: 我们在露营地搭起了帐篷。
words.en: A campground is a place where people can camp, typically in tents or recreational vehicles.

words.tr: phrase. 作物产量
words.ex: The farmer hopes for a high crop yield this year.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民希望今年有高的作物产量。
words.en: The amount of a crop that is harvested per unit of land area.

words.tr: phrase. 自然资源
words.ex: Countries protect natural resources for future generations.
words.ex_cn: 各国保护自然资源以造福后代。
words.en: Materials or substances occurring in nature which can be exploited for economic gain.

words.tr: adj. 完全透明的；极其清楚的
words.ex: The instructions were crystal-clear.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明非常清晰。
words.en: Very clear; easy to understand.

words.tr: phrase. 开花；进入盛开状态
words.ex: The flowers come into blossom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 花朵在春天盛开。
words.en: To begin to produce flowers.

words.tr: phrase. 预期寿命；平均寿命
words.ex: Life expectancy has increased in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家的预期寿命已经增加。
words.en: The average period that a person may expect to live.

words.tr: adj. 注意身体的，关注健康的
words.ex: She is health-conscious and eats only fresh vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 她很注重健康，只吃新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: A health-conscious person is someone who is concerned about their health and tries to maintain it by eating healthy food and exercising regularly.

words.tr: phrase. 克制；抑制（自己）做某事；阻止做某事
words.ex: He tries to restrain from eating too much sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他努力克制自己不要吃太多糖。
words.en: To stop yourself from doing something that you want to do, especially because it would be better not to do it.

words.tr: 名词短语，健康与健身；指身体和心理的健康状态以及通过锻炼和饮食维持或改善体能的活动
words.ex: He walks every day for health and fitness.
words.ex_cn: 他每天走路以保持健康和健身。
words.en: The overall condition of being physically and mentally well, often involving exercise and nutrition.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人对某疾病产生免疫力；给某人接种疫苗以预防某病
words.ex: The vaccine will immunise children against measles.
words.ex_cn: 这种疫苗将使儿童对麻疹产生免疫力。
words.en: To immunise someone against something means to make them immune to it, usually by giving them a vaccine.

words.tr: phrase. 一种久坐的工作；需要长时间坐着的工作
words.ex: He has a sedentary job at an office.
words.ex_cn: 他在办公室有一份久坐的工作。
words.en: A job that involves sitting for long periods with little physical activity, often associated with health risks like obesity or back pain.

words.tr: phrase. 血液循环
words.ex: Exercise improves blood circulation.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼改善血液循环。
words.en: The movement of blood through the body, driven by the heart, which delivers oxygen and nutrients to the tissues and removes carbon dioxide and other wastes.

words.tr: 感到焕然一新；感到精神焕发
words.ex: She feels refreshed after a short nap.
words.ex_cn: 她小睡一会儿后感觉精神焕发。
words.en: Feel refreshed: To experience a renewed sense of energy, vitality, and mental clarity.

words.w: take its toll on one's health
words.tr: phrase. 对某人的健康造成损害；使健康恶化
words.ex: Working long hours takes its toll on his health.
words.ex_cn: 长时间工作对他的健康造成了影响。
words.en: To have a negative effect on someone's health, often over a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 患上一种疾病；感染某种疾病
words.ex: He contracted a disease from dirty water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了脏水后染上了一种疾病。
words.en: To become infected with or develop a specific illness.

words.w: get a clean bill of health
words.tr: 短语动词. 获得健康证明；被确认健康；通过检查或评估而被认为没有问题
words.uk: ɡet ə klen bɪl əv helθ
words.us: ɡet ə klen bɪl əv helθ
words.ex: The doctor said he got a clean bill of health after the check-up.
words.ex_cn: 医生说他体检后得到了健康证明。
words.en: To be declared healthy or in good condition after a check-up or inspection.

words.tr: phrase. 高胆固醇的；指血液中胆固醇水平过高的状态
words.ex: He has high cholesterol and must eat less fat.
words.ex_cn: 他胆固醇高，必须少吃脂肪。
words.en: High cholesterol refers to an excessive level of cholesterol in the blood, which can increase the risk of cardiovascular diseases.

words.tr: phrase. 身体健壮的；精力充沛的；健康的（多用于形容年长者身体硬朗）
words.ex: My grandfather is hale and hearty at 85.
words.ex_cn: 我祖父85岁了，身体依然健壮。
words.en: In good health and full of energy.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏；不足
words.ex: He is deficient in vitamin D.
words.ex_cn: 他缺乏维生素D。
words.en: to lack something that is needed or essential

words.tr: phrase. 多元文化社会；由多种族、多文化群体共同组成的社会
words.ex: Canada is a multicultural society with many different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 加拿大是一个拥有许多不同文化的多元文化社会。
words.en: A society composed of people from diverse cultural backgrounds living together.

words.tr: adj. 习惯的；习俗的；
words.ex: It is customary to shake hands when you meet someone.
words.ex_cn: 见面时握手是习惯做法。
words.en: Something that is customary is normal because it is the way something is usually done.

words.tr: phrase. 核心价值观；基本信念；根本价值
words.ex: My family teaches me core values like honesty and kindness.
words.ex_cn: 我的家人教我诚实和善良等核心价值观。
words.en: The fundamental beliefs or principles that guide a person or group's behavior.

words.tr: phrase. 结合机制；粘结机理（指使两个物体或材料结合在一起的原理或过程）
words.ex: The bonding mechanism holds the two pieces together.
words.ex_cn: 这种粘合机制将两片材料粘在一起。
words.en: A bonding mechanism refers to the process or system by which two or more elements are joined together, often to form a strong and durable connection.

words.tr: phrase. 不言而喻的规则；未明说但被普遍遵守的规范
words.ex: He followed the unspoken rules of the team.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守了团队的不成文规定。
words.en: Unwritten social norms or expectations that govern behavior without being formally stated.

words.tr: adj. 原始的；简陋的；
words.ex: The tribe lives in a primitive hut.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在原始的小屋里。
words.en: Belonging to a very early period in the history of the world, or to a time before modern things existed.

words.tr: v. 销声匿迹；突然消失；
words.ex: The magic trick made the coin vanish.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让硬币销声匿迹了。
words.en: If someone or something vanishes, they disappear suddenly or in a way that cannot be explained.

words.tr: adj. 怀旧的；乡愁的
words.ex: He felt nostalgic when he saw his old toy.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到自己的旧玩具时，他感到怀旧。
words.en: If you feel nostalgic, you feel both happy and slightly sad when you think about things that happened in the past.

words.tr: 短语动词. 再次流行起来；重新受到欢迎
words.ex: Classic video games have a resurgence in popularity among young players.
words.ex_cn: 经典电子游戏在年轻玩家中重新流行起来。
words.en: To experience a renewed increase in popularity or interest.

words.tr: phrase. 通用语；混合语
words.ex: English is a lingua franca in international business.
words.ex_cn: 英语是国际商务中的通用语言。
words.en: A lingua franca is a language or way of communicating which is used between people who do not speak one another's native language.

words.tr: phrase. 紧密团结的社区；关系密切的群体
words.ex: They live in a close-knit community where everyone knows each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们生活在一个彼此都认识的紧密社区中。
words.en: A close-knit community is a group of people who are closely connected and supportive of each other.

words.tr: 短语. 正在建设中；施工中
words.ex: The bridge is under construction.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥正在建设中。
words.en: If a building or other structure is under construction, it is being built.

words.tr: 短语. 用于展示……的橱窗；展示……的平台
words.ex: The art fair is a showcase for local artists.
words.ex_cn: 艺术博览会是本地艺术家的展示平台。
words.en: An opportunity to display or demonstrate something, often to impress others.

words.tr: v. 强加；“impose”的现在分词； adj. 壮观的；
words.ex: He imposed his rules on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的规则强加给团队。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as imposing, you mean that they have an impressive appearance or manner.

words.tr: phrase. 明亮且通风的；轻盈通透的；轻松明快的
words.ex: The room is light and airy with big windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有大窗户，明亮又通风。
words.en: Light and airy describes something that is not heavy and allows air to move freely, creating a sense of openness and freshness.

words.tr: phrase. 重要的地标
words.ex: The old church is a significant landmark in the town.
words.ex_cn: 这座老教堂是镇上重要的地标。
words.en: A significant landmark is a prominent or well-known feature of a landscape or city that is easily recognizable and holds importance.

words.tr: phrase. 商业建筑；用于商业活动（如办公、零售、服务等）的建筑物
words.ex: The new commercial building has five floors.
words.ex_cn: 这座新的商业大楼有五层。
words.en: A commercial building is a structure that is used for business purposes, such as offices, retail stores, or other commercial activities.

words.tr: 短语. 与……大不相同；远非……
words.ex: This new phone is a far cry from the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机和旧手机大不相同。
words.en: phrase. Very different from something.

words.tr: phrase. 燃放烟花；点烟花
words.ex: They set off fireworks on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 他们在除夕夜放烟花。
words.en: To ignite and release fireworks into the air for celebration or display.

words.tr: phrase. 鸣钟迎接新年；以钟声宣告新年的到来
words.ex: We ring in the new year with fireworks at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 我们在午夜用烟花迎接新年。
words.en: To celebrate the arrival of the new year, often with festivities or special events.

words.tr: phrase. v. 过分；做得太过分；全力以赴
words.ex: He went overboard with the decorations for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对装饰得太过分了。
words.en: To do something to an excessive or extreme degree, often beyond what is considered reasonable or necessary.

words.tr: phrase. 玩得很开心
words.ex: We have a blast at the park every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周末在公园都玩得很开心。
words.en: To have a very enjoyable time.

words.tr: phrase. 放松；无拘无束；尽情享乐
words.ex: After the exam, she let her hair down and danced with friends.
words.ex_cn: 考试后，她放松下来，和朋友们一起跳舞。
words.en: To relax and enjoy oneself without worrying about what others think.

words.tr: phrase. 感觉不自在；觉得格格不入；感到自己不属于某个环境
words.ex: He feels out of place at the party because he doesn't know anyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上感到格格不入，因为他不认识任何人。
words.en: To feel uncomfortable or not belong in a particular situation or environment.

words.tr: phrase. 扫兴的人或事物；泼冷水者
words.ex: He is a wet blanket at every party.
words.ex_cn: 他在每个派对上都是个扫兴的人。
words.en: A person or thing that spoils other people's enjoyment or enthusiasm.

words.tr: phrase. 发挥监管作用；起调控作用
words.ex: The government plays a regulatory role in the market.
words.ex_cn: 政府在市场中发挥监管作用。
words.en: To function as a means of controlling or directing activities according to rules.

words.tr: phrase. 对某物实施禁令；禁止某事
words.ex: The government imposed a ban on plastic bags.
words.ex_cn: 政府禁止使用塑料袋。
words.en: To officially forbid something by law or rule.

words.tr: phrase. 应当废除某事物；表示建议或义务，意为‘应该废除某物’
words.ex: The government should abolish the old tax law.
words.ex_cn: 政府应该废除旧的税法。
words.en: To officially end or put a stop to something, especially a law or system.

words.tr: 短语. 位于政府议程的优先位置；政府重点关心的事项
words.ex: Clean water is high on the government's agenda.
words.ex_cn: 清洁用水在政府的议程中占据重要位置。
words.en: Of great importance or priority in the government's plans or schedule.

words.tr: adj. 严酷的；苛刻的
words.ex: The school has draconian rules about phone use.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校对手机使用有极其严厉的规定。
words.en: Draconian laws or measures are extremely harsh and severe.

words.tr: phrase. 严格的措施；严厉的手段
words.ex: The government imposed stringent measures to control pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府实施了严格的措施来控制污染。
words.en: Stringent measures refer to strict and rigorous actions or regulations implemented to achieve a specific goal, often in response to a critical situation.

words.tr: phrase. 抵消某事物；对抗；中和（某种影响或作用）
words.ex: He takes medicine to counteract the pain.
words.ex_cn: 他吃药来缓解疼痛。
words.en: To counteract something means to reduce its effect by doing something that has an opposite effect.

words.tr: phrase. 一个反复出现的问题；一再发生的难题
words.ex: He faces a recurring problem with his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他总是遇到电脑的问题。
words.en: A problem that happens repeatedly over time.

words.w: it is short-sighted to do sth.
words.tr: phrase. 做某事是目光短浅的；做某事缺乏远见
words.ex: It is short-sighted to ignore climate change.
words.ex_cn: 忽视气候变化是短视的。
words.en: Unwise or lacking foresight, focusing only on immediate benefits.

words.w: have the authority to do sth.
words.tr: phrase. 有权做某事；有权力或资格做某事
words.uk: hæv ði ɔːˈθɒrɪti tuː duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: hæv ði əˈθɔːrəti tuː duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: The teacher has the authority to decide the exam date.
words.ex_cn: 老师有权决定考试日期。
words.en: To possess the official power or right to perform a specific action.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对某物拥有垄断权；独家控制某事物
words.ex: The company has a monopoly over the water supply.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司垄断了供水。
words.en: To have complete control over a particular product or service, preventing others from sharing the market.

words.tr: 国防：指一个国家为保卫自身的领土、主权、安全和利益而采取的一切措施和行动。
words.ex: The government spends money on national defence.
words.ex_cn: 政府在国防上花钱。
words.en: The protection of a nation's territory, sovereignty, and interests from external threats.

words.tr: phrase. 预算赤字
words.ex: The government has a big budget deficit this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年政府有巨大的预算赤字。
words.en: A budget deficit occurs when expenses exceed revenue and indicate the financial health of a country. The government generally uses the term budget deficit when referring to spending rather than businesses or individuals. Budget deficits affect the national debt, the sum of annual budget deficits, and the cumulative total a country owes to creditors.

words.tr: 短语. 由纳税人负担费用；花纳税人的钱
words.ex: The new office was built at the taxpayer's expense.
words.ex_cn: 这个新办公室是用纳税人的钱建造的。
words.en: Paid for by the taxpayers, often implying that the cost is borne by the public through taxes.

words.tr: phrase. 给...补贴，资助
words.ex: The government subsidise education for poor students.
words.ex_cn: 政府为贫困学生提供教育补贴。
words.en: To subsidise something means to support it financially, typically by a government or public body, to keep prices low or to help an industry or service to survive.

words.tr: phrase. 贸易壁垒；贸易障碍（指限制国际贸易的政策或措施）
words.ex: The two countries removed trade barriers to help businesses.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家消除了贸易壁垒以帮助企业。
words.en: Trade barriers are measures that governments or public authorities introduce to make imported goods or services less competitive than locally produced goods and services.

words.tr: phrase. 饥饿与贫困
words.ex: Many children suffer from hunger and poverty in remote areas.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在偏远地区遭受饥饿和贫困。
words.en: The state of lacking sufficient food and living in poverty.

words.tr: adj. 弱势的；下层社会的；贫困的
words.ex: The school helps underprivileged children learn to read.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校帮助弱势儿童学习阅读。
words.en: People who are underprivileged lack the advantages that other people have, such as enough money or a good standard of living.

words.tr: phrase. 健康保险；医疗保险
words.ex: He bought health insurance for his family.
words.ex_cn: 他为家人购买了医疗保险。
words.en: Health insurance is a type of insurance coverage that pays for medical and surgical expenses incurred by the insured. Health insurance can reimburse the insured for expenses incurred from illness or injury, or pay the care provider directly.

words.tr: phrase. 国际援助；对外援助
words.ex: The country received international aid after the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 地震后，这个国家收到了国际援助。
words.en: Assistance provided by one country or an international organization to another, typically in the form of money, goods, or services, to support development, emergency relief, or welfare.

words.tr: phrase. 维护社会稳定；保障社会安定
words.ex: The government works to safeguard social stability.
words.ex_cn: 政府努力维护社会稳定。
words.en: To protect and maintain social order and peace.

words.tr: phrase. 慢性的；长期存在的问题
words.ex: He has a chronic problem with his back.
words.ex_cn: 他长期有背痛问题。
words.en: A chronic problem is a long-standing issue that persists over time and is often difficult to resolve.

words.tr: phrase. 处理；处置；摆脱某物
words.ex: He disposed of the old TV.
words.ex_cn: 他处理掉了那台旧电视。
words.en: To get rid of something that is no longer wanted or needed.

words.tr: phrase. 恶性循环；无法摆脱的困境
words.ex: He keeps spending money and getting deeper in debt — it's a vicious circle.
words.ex_cn: 他不断花钱，债务越来越重——这就是一个恶性循环。
words.en: A situation in which one problem causes another problem, which then makes the first problem worse.

words.tr: phrase. 不可生物降解的材料；无法被微生物分解的材料
words.ex: Plastic is a non-biodegradable material.
words.ex_cn: 塑料是一种不可生物降解的材料。
words.en: A substance that does not break down naturally in the environment.

words.tr: phrase. 浪费地使用某物；挥霍某物
words.ex: He uses water wastefully by leaving the tap running.
words.ex_cn: 他让水龙头一直开着，浪费了水。
words.en: To use something in a way that is not careful or efficient, leading to unnecessary consumption or loss.

words.tr: n. 生物圈；生物界；
words.ex: The biosphere includes all living things on Earth.
words.ex_cn: 生物圈包括地球上所有生物。
words.en: The biosphere is the part of the Earth's surface and atmosphere in which plants and animals can live.

words.tr: phrase. 臭氧层
words.ex: The ozone layer protects us from the sun's harmful rays.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧层保护我们免受太阳有害射线的伤害。
words.en: The ozone layer is a layer in the Earth's stratosphere that contains a high concentration of ozone (O3) molecules, which absorb most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation.

words.tr: 造成不可逆转的损害
words.ex: The pollution caused irreversible damage to the river.
words.ex_cn: 污染对河流造成了不可逆转的损害。
words.en: To inflict harm that cannot be undone or repaired.

words.tr: phrase. 全球变暖
words.ex: Global warming is making the Earth hotter.
words.ex_cn: 全球变暖正在让地球变得更热。
words.en: Global warming refers to the long-term increase in Earth's average surface temperature due to human activities, primarily fossil fuel burning, which increases heat-trapping greenhouse gas levels in Earth's atmosphere.

words.tr: phrase. 汽车排放物；汽车尾气
words.ex: The car emissions are very high.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的尾气排放很高。
words.en: The gases and particles that are released into the air by cars as a result of the combustion of fuel.

words.tr: phrase. 土壤侵蚀
words.ex: Heavy rain causes soil erosion on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致山坡上的土壤侵蚀。
words.en: The process by which the surface of the earth is worn away by the action of water, glaciers, winds, waves, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 化学肥料；通过化学方法制成的用于促进植物生长的肥料
words.ex: The farmer uses chemical fertiliser to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用化学肥料来种植庄稼。
words.en: A chemical fertiliser is a substance added to soil to improve its fertility and promote plant growth.

words.tr: phrase. 酸雨
words.ex: Acid rain kills trees and fish.
words.ex_cn: 酸雨杀死树木和鱼类。
words.en: Rainfall made sufficiently acidic by atmospheric pollution that it causes environmental harm, typically to forests and lakes. The main cause is the industrial burning of coal and other fossil fuels, the waste gases from which contain sulfur and nitrogen oxides which combine with atmospheric water to form acids.

words.tr: phrase. 破坏生态系统；扰乱生态平衡
words.ex: Pollution can upset the ecosystem.
words.ex_cn: 污染会破坏生态系统。
words.en: To disrupt or disturb the natural equilibrium of an environment.

words.tr: phrase. 工业废料；工业废弃物
words.ex: The factory dumps industrial waste into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂把工业废料倒入河里。
words.en: Industrial waste refers to the waste produced by industrial activity which includes any material that is rendered useless during a manufacturing process such as that of factories, industries, mills, and mining operations.

words.tr: phrase. 在损害...的情况下
words.ex: He succeeded at the expense of his health.
words.ex_cn: 他成功了，但牺牲了自己的健康。
words.en: If something is done at the expense of someone or something else, it is done in a way that harms them or is unfair to them.

words.tr: phrase. 石油短缺；油荒
words.ex: The country faces an oil shortage this winter.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家今年冬天面临石油短缺。
words.en: A situation in which there is not enough oil available to meet the demand.

words.tr: phrase. 矿物燃料
words.ex: Cars use fossil fuel to move.
words.ex_cn: 汽车使用化石燃料行驶。
words.en: Fossil fuels are fuels formed by natural processes such as anaerobic decomposition of buried dead organisms, containing energy originating in ancient photosynthesis.

words.tr: phrase. 让某人感到烦躁；使某人恼火
words.ex: The loud music next door gets on my nerves.
words.ex_cn: 隔壁的吵闹音乐让我很烦。
words.en: To irritate or annoy someone.

words.tr: phrase. 动物权利；指动物应享有免受虐待和剥削的基本权利
words.ex: People fight for animal rights to stop cruelty.
words.ex_cn: 人们为动物权利而斗争，以阻止虐待。
words.en: The idea that animals should have moral and legal rights similar to those of humans.

words.tr: phrase. 食物链
words.ex: The lion is at the top of the food chain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子处于食物链的顶端。
words.en: A food chain is a series of organisms each dependent on the next as a source of food.

words.tr: phrase. 制药公司；药品生产企业
words.ex: He works for a pharmaceutical company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家制药公司工作。
words.en: A business that researches, develops, and sells medicines and health products.

words.tr: phrase. 成为好伙伴；成为好伴侣
words.ex: Dogs make good companions for old people.
words.ex_cn: 狗是老年人的好伙伴。
words.en: To form a good relationship or partnership with someone or something.

words.tr: 状态良好：指物品或人的状态良好，没有损坏或疾病。
words.ex: The car is in good condition.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车状况良好。
words.en: If something is in good condition, it is in a good state or quality, especially because it has been well looked after.

words.tr: phrase. 无多余装饰的；朴实无华的；只提供基本服务的
words.ex: The airline offers no frills flights to save money.
words.ex_cn: 这家航空公司提供无附加服务的航班以节省费用。
words.en: No frills refers to something that is basic and without any unnecessary extras or decorations, often used to describe services or products that are simple and functional.

words.tr: adj. 粗笨的；笨重的
words.ex: The old computer is clunky and slow.
words.ex_cn: 这台旧电脑笨重又缓慢。
words.en: If you describe something as clunky, you mean that it is heavy, awkward, and not efficient or elegant.

words.tr: phrase. 促进发展；使发展更容易进行
words.ex: The teacher helps to facilitate the development of student skills.
words.ex_cn: 老师帮助促进学生技能的发展。
words.en: To make the development of something easier or more likely to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 落后；滞后；跟不上
words.ex: Tom often lags behind in class because he doesn't study.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆因为不学习，经常在课堂上落后。
words.en: To fail to keep up with others or to fall behind in progress, development, or achievement.

words.tr: phrase. 社会变革的工具；推动社会变革的手段
words.ex: Education is an instrument of social change.
words.ex_cn: 教育是社会变革的工具。
words.en: A means or tool through which social change is effected or facilitated.

words.tr: 短语. ……的变化；……的转变
words.ex: There is a shift in his attitude toward homework.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度有了变化。
words.en: A change or movement from one state, position, or direction to another.

words.w: economic swings of boom and slump
words.tr: phrase. 经济繁荣与萧条的周期性波动
words.uk: ˌiːkəˈnɒmɪk swɪŋz əv buːm ənd slʌmp
words.us: ˌɛkəˈnɑmɪk swɪŋz əv buːm ənd slʌmp
words.ex: The economy shows economic swings of boom and slump every few years.
words.ex_cn: 经济每隔几年就会出现繁荣与萧条的波动。
words.en: The fluctuations between periods of economic growth and decline.

words.tr: phrase. 影响深远的；具有广泛后果的
words.ex: The accident had far-reaching effects on the village.
words.ex_cn: 这起事故对村庄产生了深远的影响。
words.en: Consequences or impacts that are extensive and affect many areas or people.

words.tr: phrase. 知识经济；以知识和信息为主要生产要素的经济形态
words.ex: The country is building a knowledge economy through education and technology.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家通过教育和技术建设知识经济。
words.en: An economy based on the production, distribution, and use of knowledge and information.

words.tr: phrase. 持续不断的城市化
words.ex: Relentless urbanisation is forcing many farmers to move to cities.
words.ex_cn: 持续不断的城市化正迫使许多农民搬到城市。
words.en: The continuous and often uncontrolled growth and expansion of cities.

words.tr: phrase. 中央商务区；城市中商业和办公活动集中的区域
words.ex: The shops are in the central business district.
words.ex_cn: 商店位于中央商务区。
words.en: The primary commercial and financial heart of a city or town.

words.tr: 短语动词. 被某事物淘汰或取代，变得过时
words.ex: Typewriters were rendered obsolete by computers.
words.ex_cn: 打字机被电脑取代了。
words.en: To be made outdated or no longer useful by something.

words.tr: phrase. 人口出生率
words.ex: The birth rate in this country is falling.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的出生率正在下降。
words.en: The birth rate is the number of live births per thousand of population per year.

words.tr: adj. 挤满的；过度拥挤的；
words.ex: The bus was overcrowded at rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段公交车挤满了人。
words.en: If a place is overcrowded, there are too many people or things in it.

words.tr: adj. 老式的；老派的；守旧的
words.ex: He wears an old-fashioned hat.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着一顶过时的帽子。
words.en: If you describe something as old-fashioned, you mean that it is no longer modern, current, or fashionable.

words.tr: phrase. , 眼下；现阶段
words.ex: At this stage, he is learning to read.
words.ex_cn: 在这个阶段，他正在学习阅读。
words.en: At a particular point or step in a process or series of events.

words.tr: phrase. 开创；开启
words.ex: The new technology will usher in a better future.
words.ex_cn: 这项新技术将开启一个更美好的未来。
words.en: To usher in something means to be at the start of a new period, especially one that involves important changes or improvements.

words.tr: phrase. 不再是必需品；已非必要
words.ex: Smartphones are no longer a necessity for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机对每个人来说不再是一种必需品。
words.en: Something that is no longer required or essential.

words.tr: adj. 产生相反效果的；适得其反的；事与愿违的；
words.ex: Yelling at him is counterproductive.
words.ex_cn: 对他大喊大叫会产生相反的效果。
words.en: Something that is counterproductive achieves the opposite result from the one that you want to achieve.

words.tr: phrase. 古老的；由来已久的（问题）
words.ex: This is an age-old problem in every society.
words.ex_cn: 这是每个社会中一个古老的问题。
words.en: A problem that has existed for a very long time.

words.tr: phrase. 给……带来问题；对……构成难题
words.ex: The new rule poses a problem for small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 新规定给小企业带来了问题。
words.en: To create a difficulty or issue for someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 繁荣的经济；蓬勃发展的经济
words.ex: The country has a thriving economy with low unemployment.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家有一个繁荣的经济，失业率很低。
words.en: An economy that is growing strongly, with high levels of business activity and prosperity.

words.tr: phrase. （特征、疾病或才能）世代相传；家族遗传
words.ex: Being good at singing runs in the family.
words.ex_cn: 擅长唱歌是我们家的家族特点。
words.en: If a quality, ability, disease, etc. runs in the family, many members of the family have it.

words.tr: phrase. 对……的依恋；附属物；连接
words.ex: He has a strong attachment to his old toy.
words.ex_cn: 他对他的旧玩具有很强的感情。
words.en: A feeling of affection or loyalty to someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭关系；亲情
words.ex: Family bonds help people feel safe and loved.
words.ex_cn: 家庭纽带让人感到安全和被爱。
words.en: The emotional connections and relationships within a family that unite its members.

words.tr: phrase. 义务感；责任感
words.ex: He felt a sense of obligation to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有义务帮助他的朋友。
words.en: A feeling that you must do something because it is your duty or because you feel you owe it to someone.

words.tr: n. 养家糊口的人
words.ex: He is the breadwinner in his family.
words.ex_cn: 他是家里的经济支柱。
words.en: A breadwinner is a person who earns money to support their family.

words.tr: phrase. 想当然认为···
words.ex: He takes his health for granted.
words.ex_cn: 他把健康视为理所当然。
words.en: If you take something for granted, you believe it to be true or accept it as normal or without questioning it.

words.tr: phrase. 感到想家的；思乡的
words.ex: He feels homesick when he is away from his family.
words.ex_cn: 当他远离家人时，他会感到想家。
words.en: To feel homesick means to feel unhappy because you are away from home and missing your family, friends, and familiar surroundings.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对某事有美好的回忆；深情地回忆某事
words.ex: She has fond recollections of her childhood days.
words.ex_cn: 她对童年时光有美好的回忆。
