words.en: To remember something with pleasure and affection.

words.tr: phrase. 家务活；家庭杂务
words.ex: He does household chores every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上做家务。
words.en: Tasks such as cleaning, washing, and cooking that are done regularly to keep a house running smoothly.

words.tr: phrase. 爱与奉献；深情与忠诚
words.ex: She showed love and devotion to her family every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天都对家人表现出爱与奉献。
words.en: A strong feeling of deep affection and commitment towards someone or something.

words.w: absence makes the heart grow fonder.
words.tr: 谚语. 距离产生美；久别胜新婚（指分离使人更加珍惜感情）
words.ex: He missed his girlfriend so much while she was away; absence makes the heart grow fonder.
words.ex_cn: 当她离开时，他非常想念她；距离让感情更深。
words.en: This proverb means that when people we love are not with us, we love them even more.

words.tr: phrase. 某人最珍爱的人或物；掌上明珠
words.ex: Her little brother is the apple of her eye.
words.ex_cn: 她弟弟是她的心肝宝贝。
words.en: The phrase 'apple of one's eye' refers to someone or something that is very precious or dear to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；教育；养育；呕出
words.ex: He brought up an important point in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个重要的观点。
words.en: To mention a subject or start to talk about it; to care for a child until they are an adult, often giving them particular beliefs; to educate someone; to vomit.

words.tr: n. 抚养子女；育儿
words.ex: Parents learn child-rearing from their own parents.
words.ex_cn: 父母从自己的父母那里学习育儿。
words.en: The process of bringing up and educating children.

words.tr: phrase. 母性本能；母亲天生照顾和保护子女的本能
words.ex: Her maternal instinct made her protect the child.
words.ex_cn: 她的母性本能让她保护那个孩子。
words.en: A natural, instinctive tendency in women to care for and protect children, often associated with motherhood.

words.tr: phrase. 为某事铺平道路；为某事创造条件
words.ex: New technology can pave the way for better education.
words.ex_cn: 新技术可以为更好的教育铺平道路。
words.en: If one thing paves the way for another, it creates a situation in which it is possible or more likely to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 预防措施
words.ex: Washing hands is a preventative measure against colds.
words.ex_cn: 洗手是预防感冒的措施。
words.en: Actions taken to prevent something undesirable, such as disease or accidents, from happening.

words.tr: 谚语. 只要目的正当，可以不择手段
words.ex: He lied to get the job, but he believes the end justifies the means.
words.ex_cn: 他为了得到这份工作而撒谎，但他认为目的证明手段是合理的。
words.en: A belief that a good outcome makes any method acceptable, however unethical.

words.tr: phrase. 必要的恶；虽不受欢迎但为达成目标所必需的事物
words.ex: Taxes are a necessary evil in society.
words.ex_cn: 税收是社会中一种必要的恶。
words.en: Something that is unpleasant or harmful but must be accepted because it brings some benefit or because there is no alternative.

words.tr: phrase. 采取观望态度；暂不采取行动，静观事态发展
words.ex: He adopts a wait-and-see attitude about the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 他对新政策采取了观望态度。
words.en: To decide to delay action until more information is available.

words.tr: phrase. 火上浇油；使情况更加恶化
words.ex: His angry words add fuel to the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他愤怒的话火上浇油。
words.en: To make a bad situation worse by saying or doing something that causes more anger or problems.

words.tr: phrase. 完全弄错了方向；指责错了对象；在错误的地方努力
words.ex: If you think I took your book, you're barking up the wrong tree.
words.ex_cn: 如果你以为我拿了你的书，那你可找错人了。
words.en: To make a wrong assumption or to pursue a mistaken or misguided line of thought or course of action.

words.tr: phrase. 可行的替代方案，用来表示某事物可以作为另一个事物的切实可行的替换选择
words.ex: Biking is a feasible alternative to driving in the city.
words.ex_cn: 在城市里，骑自行车是开车的一个可行替代方案。
words.en: A practical and realistic option that can replace something else.

words.tr: phrase. 最后手段；万不得已的选择
words.ex: He took the last resort and called the police.
words.ex_cn: 他采取了最后的手段，报警了。
words.en: The final option or course of action when all others have failed.

words.tr: phrase. 处理一个问题；着手解决难题
words.ex: We must tackle a problem when it comes.
words.ex_cn: 当问题来临时，我们必须解决它。
words.en: To deal with a problem or challenge in a determined and effective way.

words.w: a desirable ideal rather than an achievable reality
words.tr: 短语. 一种令人向往的理想，而非可实现的现实
words.uk: /ə dɪˈzɜːrəbəl aɪˈdiːəl ˈrɑːðə(r) ðən ən əˈtʃiːvəbəl ˈriːələti/
words.us: /ə dɪˈzɜːrəbəl aɪˈdiːəl ˈræðər ðən ən əˈtʃiːvəbəl ˈriːələti/
words.ex: Peace in the world is a desirable ideal rather than an achievable reality.
words.ex_cn: 世界和平是一个美好的理想，但难以实现。
words.en: An ideal worth striving for but unlikely to be fully achieved.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对……有分歧的看法；对……持不同意见
words.ex: Some people have mixed views on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 一些人对气候变化有不同的看法。
words.en: To have differing opinions or perspectives on a particular topic or issue.

words.tr: phrase. 持有……的观点；认为……
words.ex: Some people take the view that school should start later.
words.ex_cn: 有些人认为学校应该晚点开始上课。
words.en: To hold or express a particular opinion or belief about something.

words.tr: phrase. 一个高度敏感或充满情绪争议的话题
words.ex: Climate change is a highly charged issue in politics.
words.ex_cn: 气候变化在政治中是一个极具争议的问题。
words.en: A highly charged issue is a topic that causes strong emotions or intense debate.

words.w: the tide of opinion is now running steadily against ...
words.tr: phrase. 舆论的潮流目前正持续转向反对……
words.uk: ðə taɪd əv ˌɒpɪˈnjuːn ɪz naʊ ˈrʌnɪŋ ˈstedɪli əˈgenst
words.us: ðə taɪd əv ˌɑːpəˈnuːn ɪz naʊ ˈrʌnɪŋ ˈstɛdɪli əˈɡenst
words.ex: The tide of opinion is now running steadily against the new law.
words.ex_cn: 舆论的潮流现在正稳步反对这项新法律。
words.en: Public opinion is increasingly opposing something.

words.tr: phrase. 理所当然的是……；合乎情理的是……；显然……
words.ex: It stands to reason that if you study hard, you will pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 如果你努力学习，通过考试是合乎逻辑的。
words.en: It is logical or reasonable to conclude that...

words.w: it is an inescapable fact that ...
words.tr: phrase. 不可避免的事实是……；无可争辩的事实是……
words.ex: It is an inescapable fact that the climate is changing.
words.ex_cn: 不可避免的事实是，气候正在变化。
words.en: A fact that cannot be avoided or denied.

words.tr: adj. 显而易见的；
words.ex: The change in her mood was noticeable.
words.ex_cn: 她情绪的变化显而易见。
words.en: Something that is noticeable is very obvious, so that it is easy to see, hear, or recognize.

words.tr: phrase. 根本原因；潜在原因
words.ex: The underlying cause of his illness is stress.
words.ex_cn: 他生病的根本原因是压力。
words.en: The fundamental reason or basis of something, often not immediately obvious.

words.tr: phrase. 看到上升趋势；观察到增长或改善的动向
words.ex: We can see an upward trend in the number of people using bikes.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以看到使用自行车的人数呈上升趋势。
words.en: To observe a rise or increase in something, typically over a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 迅速上升到；猛增至；飞涨到
words.ex: The small company rocketed to success after launching a new app.
words.ex_cn: 这家小公司在推出一款新应用后迅速取得了成功。
words.en: To increase or rise very quickly and suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 达到（某数值）的峰值；在…达到最高点
words.ex: The temperature peaks at 30 degrees in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天温度最高达到30度。
words.en: To reach the highest point or level of something.

words.tr: phrase. 一次衰退；萧条；萎靡不振
words.ex: The economy is in a slump.
words.ex_cn: 经济正处于低迷期。
words.en: A slump is a period of poor performance or inactivity in an economy, market, or business.

words.tr: phrase. 持续稳定地下降或减少
words.ex: The temperature falls consistently in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天温度持续下降。
words.en: To decrease steadily over a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 骤降至；暴跌到
words.ex: The temperature will plummet to -10 degrees tonight.
words.ex_cn: 今晚气温将骤降至零下10度。
words.en: To fall or drop straight down at high speed.

words.tr: phrase. （价格、价值等）跌至最低点，触底；（经济状况）降至最低水平后趋于稳定
words.ex: The price of oil bottomed out last month.
words.ex_cn: 油价上个月触底了。
words.en: To reach the lowest point or level, after which no further decline occurs.

words.tr: phrase. 达到稳定阶段；进入停滞期；趋于平稳
words.ex: After losing 10 pounds, she reached a plateau and stopped losing weight.
words.ex_cn: 在减掉10磅后，她达到了一个平台期，体重不再下降。
words.en: To reach a plateau means to stop increasing or progressing after a period of rapid growth or improvement, and to remain at a stable level.

words.tr: v. 超过；
words.ex: The car exceeded the speed limit.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车超过了限速。
words.en: To be greater in quantity, degree, or intensity than something else.

words.tr:
n. 两倍；
v. 加倍；是…的两倍；把…对折；
words.ex: He earned a double of his salary last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月赚了两倍的薪水。
words.en: If something is double, it is twice as much or twice as many. If you double something, you make it twice as much or twice as many.

words.tr: phrase. 与……形成鲜明对比；与……截然不同
words.ex: He likes quiet books, in stark contrast with his brother who loves action movies.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢安静的书，与他喜欢动作片的哥哥形成鲜明对比。
words.en: used to say that one thing is very different from another

words.tr: phrase. 由...组成
words.ex: The team is composed of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名队员组成。
words.en: If something is composed of particular things, people, or elements, it is made from those things, people, or elements.

words.tr: phrase. 与…成反比；随着…的增加而减少
words.ex: The speed is in inverse proportion to the time.
words.ex_cn: 速度与时间成反比。
words.en: In inverse proportion to means that as one quantity increases, the other decreases at a corresponding rate.

words.tr: phrase. 对应的数字或图形
words.ex: The corresponding figure is 5.
words.ex_cn: 相应的数字是5。
words.en: The term 'the corresponding figure' refers to a specific number or graphical representation that matches or relates to a particular context or comparison.

words.tr: adv. 尤其；
words.ex: He likes all fruits, notably apples.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢所有水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: You use notably to specify an important or typical example of something that you are talking about.

words.tr: adv. 即；也就是；
words.ex: He has three hobbies, namely reading, swimming, and painting.
words.ex_cn: 他有三个爱好，即阅读、游泳和绘画。
words.en: You use namely to introduce detailed information about the subject you are discussing, or a particular aspect of it.

words.tr: adv. 本质上；基本上；根本上；
words.ex: He is essentially a kind person.
words.ex_cn: 他本质上是个善良的人。
words.en: You use essentially to indicate that what you are saying is mainly true, although there may be some exceptions or qualifications.

words.tr: adv. 尤其；特别；
words.ex: I like fruits, particularly apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Used to single out a subject to which a statement is especially applicable.

words.tr: adv. 仅仅；
words.ex: He is merely a student.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅是个学生。
words.en: You use merely to emphasize that something is only what you say and not better, more important, or more exciting.

words.tr: adv. 实际地；现实地；
words.ex: We need to plan realistically about the budget.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要实际地规划预算。
words.en: In a way that shows a sensible and practical idea of what can be achieved or expected.

words.tr: adv. 在历史上
words.ex: Historically, people used abacus for counting.
words.ex_cn: 历史上，人们用算盘进行计算。
words.en: In a way that relates to the study of past events.

words.tr: adv. 大幅度地；相当地；很大地；
words.ex: The price has increased considerably.
words.ex_cn: 价格大幅上涨了。
words.en: To a notably large or significant extent.

words.tr: adv. 相对地；
words.ex: This room is relatively small.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间相对较小。
words.en: In comparison with other similar things or with what you expect.

words.tr: adv. 相应地
words.ex: He works hard, and correspondingly, he gets good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，相应地，他取得了好成绩。
words.en: In a way that corresponds to something else; in a corresponding manner.
